subject: Upload data error: 413 Request Entity Too Large

messages.author: 3774f6bb86cfea15
messages.subject: Upload data error: 413 Request Entity Too Large
parts:
I am having trouble uploading large files in my shiny app. It seems like anything over about 1 MB fails to upload. I get a 413 error: 
<html> <head><title>413 Request Entity Too Large</title></head> 

I googled around and tried increasing the file upload size by putting this line at the top of my server.R file
options(shiny.maxRequestSize= -1)

I still get the same error. What is going on my with app? I'm stuck. 

I attached a screenshot of the file upload error.

messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Re: Upload data error: 413 Request Entity Too Large
